## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The release gate change has to be fixed before merge: with the default minimum, a release that has exactly two approvals is now blocked.

## Changes
The pull request regenerates `aaa-generated/catalog.json`, renaming 1,500 `legacy-service-NNNN` entries to `production-service-NNNN` and moving their ports from 10000–11499 to 20000–21499. It also rewrites `healthy()` in `services/registry.py` to use `not failures` and changes the approval comparison in `zzz-release/gate.py` from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` in the approval comparison — Calling `approved(2, minimum=2)` now returns `False`, because `approvals > minimum` rejects the case where approvals equal the minimum. This contradicts the module docstring at `zzz-release/gate.py:1`: "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." — Releases that meet the configured approval minimum exactly are blocked, so every release needs one approval more than policy requires. — Fix: Restore `approvals >= minimum` and extend `tests/test_release.py::test_approved_release` with the `approved(2, minimum=2)` case; today it only checks 3 approvals, and the blocked test only checks 1.
